description: Home Assistant add-ons that wrap one of chiva's own images. The wrapped release is pinned in three places that must move together: the Dockerfile ARG default, build.yaml's build_from and config.yaml's version (annotated with a '# renovate:' comment).

customManagers.description: build.yaml build_from tags: the per-arch base the Home Assistant builder injects.
config.yaml version: the tag the Supervisor pulls. The preceding comment names the wrapped image.

packageRules.description: The wrapped image is tracked by readable tag so the three pins stay in lockstep and match the signed upstream release; digest pinning would break that. Actions keep their SHA pins.
One PR per upstream release across all three pins, with no stability wait: the release already passed the upstream repo's CI and the add-on should follow it.
